subject.title: fix: keep the global loop breaker reachable after tool blocks

question: Should OpenClaw standardize loop-detector vetoes as a typed diagnostic outcome in this PR, or adopt the competing sentinel-hash representation from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109619?
rationale: Both branches address the same confirmed availability defect and provide plausible proof, but the representation becomes a runtime diagnostic-state contract that should have one owner-approved canonical form.

options.title: Adopt the typed outcome design
options.body: Merge this PR after rebase if the owner agrees that `outcome: "loop-veto"` is the clearest non-progress representation and keep its reset-boundary coverage.

options.title: Adopt the sentinel-hash design
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109619 instead if the owner prefers keeping all no-progress state in result hashes, then close this PR as superseded.

options.title: Request a unified narrow patch
options.body: Ask one contributor to consolidate the chosen semantics and tests into a single rebased implementation before either PR lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt the typed outcome design
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after rebase if the owner agrees that `outcome: "loop-veto"` is the clearest non-progress representation and keep its reset-boundary coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Release history connects this contributor to the original global circuit-breaker behavior whose diagnostic representation and escalation semantics are being refined.
